data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $60,654,000 there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on the 2019 underwriting year increasing gross claims estimates (gross strengthening per claims development table).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced adverse prior-year reserve development driven by IBNR recalibration and changes to reserving assumptions. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a gross strengthening primarily on the 2019 underwriting year of approximately $13.504m (USD), representing an increase of about 16.8% versus the opening gross claims outstanding. The managing agent cites reserving uncertainty, additional pricing and claims information, and margins added above actuarial best estimates as contributing factors.
raw_causal_phrases: there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).
margin added over and above actuarial best estimates
back year deterioration on a GAAP basis
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not stated explicitly as a gross single-figure movement in the notes; the gross PYD was derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing the 2019 column current estimate to its prior diagonal (one year earlier). The narrative sentence in the report provides a NET deterioration ($5.306m) which differs from the gross triangle-derived amount; the reported exact sentence is provided above. Detailed regulatory statutory class premium breakout was not provided; a geographic premium analysis was used for gross_premium_mix.
